races.name: Lisa Margaret Turner Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Last-time-out winners FAIRLAWN SKIPPER and Walk In The Valley remain low-mileage chasers who are going the right way and rate the pair to focus on. The former narrowly preferred dropped back in trip following his solid fourth in a stronger handicap at Cheltenham.

  1. FAIRLAWN SKIPPER
  2. WALK IN THE VALLEY (IRE)
  3. GLORY AND HONOUR (IRE)

races.name: Paxtons Northallerton Parts Team Power Performance Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
IN THE TRENCHES has made a sound start over fences for his new yard and he looks to have been found an excellent opportunity back over hurdles despite conceding weight all round. Multiple point scorer Farfromaway can provide chief resistance with this increase in trip promising to see him in a better light.

  1. IN THE TRENCHES
  2. FARFROMAWAY (IRE)
  3. ARCIMBOLDO

races.name: Sedgefield Christmas Jumper Raceday 22nd December Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Unexposed stayer FRISKY WHISKEY can follow up her Hexham success. Jeteye is enjoying a fine year and appeals as the most likely danger.

  1. FRISKY WHISKEY
  2. JETEYE (IRE)
  3. WEE ALKI (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Parties At Sedgefield Racecourse Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This could be a good opportunity for serial runner-up MILITARY CROSS to get his head in front. Fairly useful bumper performer Close House rates the chief danger following a breathing operation, with fellow hurdling debutant Carthusian also commanding respect.

  1. MILITARY CROSS (IRE)
  2. CLOSE HOUSE (IRE)
  3. CARTHUSIAN (IRE)

races.name: Paxtons Pity Me Workshop Top Peformance Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
SOLDIER IN MAYO has run well on 2 of 3 starts over fences and appeals as the most likely winner in a thin race. Brave Move and Alidam are potential dangers, the latter worth noting in the betting for new connections.

  1. SOLDIER IN MAYO (IRE)
  2. BRAVE MOVE (IRE)
  3. ALIDAM (FR)

races.name: Catertech North East Ltd Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Having finished second in a race that worked out well at Newcastle in the spring, MIDNIGHT BELLA didn't get the chance to show what she could do following a breathing operation/8 months off when unseating mid-race in a course novice 10 days ago. A low-mileage mare, she's well worth another chance back in a handicap over this slightly longer trip. Stellarmasterpiece has enjoyed a highly productive 2026 under both codes and is fancied to play a lead role once more.

  1. MIDNIGHT BELLA
  2. STELLARMASTERPIECE (FR)
  3. LEAVE HER TO ME

races.name: DBS And Willmott Dixon Building Together Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
It's difficult to get away from GOLLY GOSH, who has taken well to chasing for his new yard and the front-running tactics that were successfully adopted last time often work well around here. Jac Jumper is potentially well handicapped on his best form, so he could emerge as the main threat if ready to go after a lengthy lay-off, with Largy Panic rounding off the shortlist.

  1. GOLLY GOSH (IRE)
  2. JAC JUMPER (FR)
  3. LARGY PANIC (IRE)

races.name: JDA Grand Design Mares' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
This looks a good chance for GATA BAN to land a third success of the season. With doubts about Out On Her Own's stamina over 3m it could be that the class-dropping Princess Keri, who shaped better than the result on her reappearance, gives Neil Mulholland's charge most to do.

  1. GATA BAN (IRE)
  2. PRINCESS KERI (IRE)
  3. OUT ON HER OWN

races.name: BWB Consulting - Women In Engineering Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MAY CALL YOU BACK can enhance her good strike rate since joining Willie Mullins. A decent record when fresh suggests Golan Loop may bounce back to form after a breathing operation and provide the main threat.

  1. MAY CALL YOU BACK
  2. GOLAN LOOP (IRE)
  3. BALLYKINLAR (IRE)

races.name: Lexy 21st Birthday Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A good-looking bumper with the pedigrees and yards on show. HELIOS FORLONGE was bought for a handsome sum after finding only one too good on his only outing in Irish points, so makes obvious appeal on this switch to Rules having joined a quality outfit. Francisco Alvares merits attention for a stable going well with its bumper horses, while Mirage D'alene is another to note.

  1. HELIOS FORLONGE (FR)
  2. FRANCISCO ALVARES
  3. MIRAGE D'ALENE (FR)

races.name: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Mares' Novices' Hurdle
races.verdict:
CLONDAW PARK has made an encouraging start over hurdles and can put that experience to good use over Madam Speaker, who showed plenty in bumpers last season but disappointed at Uttoxeter on her return.

  1. CLONDAW PARK (IRE)
  2. MADAM SPEAKER (IRE)
  3. IT TAKES TWO

races.name: Winter Ladies Day Saturday 28th November Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NORTHWEST PASSAGE's opening mark over hurdles is an attractive one given his ability on the Flat so gets the vote. Promethean looks to be building up to something so is second choice ahead of penalised winner Character Testing.

  1. NORTHWEST PASSAGE
  2. PROMETHEAN (FR)
  3. CHARACTER TESTING

races.name: Celebrate With Sponsorship At Southwell Racecourse Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
KEEP ON COBBLING made a winning reappearance last season and can repeat the feat back in calmer waters. Bang-in-form Crafty Gael is feared most on second start for Lizzie Quinlan, with Luminaries perhaps best of the rest.

  1. KEEP ON COBBLING
  2. CRAFTY GAEL (IRE)
  3. LUMINARIES (IRE)

races.name: AIS Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GLANCING JACK's Newbury handicap debut second in March is strong form and he can make a successful reappearance for new trainer Dan Skelton. High Fibre's excellent start for the James Owen yard includes a Summer Hurdle win at Market Rasen and a fourth in the Cesarewitch at Newmarket last month so he's an obvious threat. Keno Black has a similar profile to his yard's 2024 winner of this and is next on the list ahead of Norman Fletcher and unexposed Paul Nicholls handicap newcomer Outmaster.

  1. GLANCING JACK
  2. HIGH FIBRE (IRE)
  3. KENO BLACK (FR)

races.name: Mucking Brilliant Paddy Power Novices' Chase (Listed) (Registered As The Doctor Fothergill Novices' Chase) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Henry de Bromhead has already tasted success with a novice here this autumn and his KING'S BUCKS may well become another. He shaped well sent chasing after 6 months off when second at Galway 18 days ago and with the sharp test at this trip expected to hold no fears, he could be the answer. Intosomethinggood may emerge next best, ahead of Kingston Narcissus who has stamina to prove up in trip.

  1. KING'S BUCKS (FR)
  2. INTOSOMETHINGGOOD
  3. KINGSTON NARCISSUS (FR)

races.name: Shloer Chase (Registered As The Cheltenham Chase) (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A typically small field for this year's Shloer Chase and it's hard to get away from JONBON, who bids for a third success in the race and had bottomless ground as an excuse for his below-par second last year. Fragility remains an ongoing problem for Gidleigh Park, but he can provide most resistance if returning on his A-game, with the race-fit Saint Segal taken to fill out third.

  1. JONBON (FR)
  2. GIDLEIGH PARK
  3. SAINT SEGAL (FR)

races.name: Jilly Cooper Veterans' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
TRIPLE TRADE won at this meeting last year and is building up a good record in these events, so appeals as the most solid option with his yard still thriving. Mahons Glory and Thunder Rock head the dangers.

  1. TRIPLE TRADE
  2. MAHONS GLORY (IRE)
  3. THUNDER ROCK (IRE)

races.name: Albert Bartlett Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (Registered As The Hyde) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DIVINE DIVA was back to looking much more the bright prospect she'd appeared when placed in a listed bumper at this meeting last year when scoring in good style on her recent hurdling debut at Chepstow and it looks significant Harry Skelton has chosen her over Hitintheheadlines, who accounted for 4 next-time-out winners on his first go over hurdles at the aforementioned venue. Ferocimo cruised clear in the manner of an above-average novice at Fontwell and is a very interesting contender, too.

  1. DIVINE DIVA (IRE)
  2. HITINTHEHEADLINES (IRE)
  3. FEROCIMO (IRE)

races.name: Valda Energy Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WAY OF STARS looks to have plenty in his favour in a stacked renewal, and he may well gain compensation for his Chepstow near miss. The main danger could be handicap debutant Lexington Wood, who has plenty of untapped potential, while Dan Skelton's Sytadel is another who is probably well treated. Eben Zaabeel is potentially most interesting of a healthy Irish contingent, his shrewd connections landing a touch in this corresponding race back in 2013.

  1. WAY OF STARS (IRE)
  2. LEXINGTON WOOD (FR)
  3. SYTADEL (FR)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Race
races.verdict:
CRAYONS IN THE SKY made no mistake when justifying odds-on favouritism with a bit in hand over C&D recently and Stephen Thorne's filly can confirm her superiority over Normanton, who showed much more than on debut last time and is open to further improvement. I Ready and Supreme Lord can fight out the minor placings.

  1. CRAYONS IN THE SKY
  2. NORMANTON (IRE)
  3. I READY (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for plenty of these so it could pay to take a chance on DAAMBERDIPLOMAT, who was last seen in winning action here in October last year and returns from just 1 lb higher having since joined the shrewd Ado McGuinness outfit. Caffu Zafeen arrives in search of a 5-timer, so he merits considerable respect, with All The Girls and Eddie G another couple worth considering, as well.

  1. DAAMBERDIPLOMAT (IRE)
  2. CAFFU ZAFEEN (IRE)
  3. ALL THE GIRLS (IRE)

races.name: View Restaurant At Dundalk Stadium Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
CLOSEFIELD BEAU has taken well to all-weather and he can defy a 3 lb rise with this extra 1f expected to suit. Shenata remains with potential having had excuses last time so is second choice.

  1. CLOSEFIELD BEAU (IRE)
  2. SHENATA (IRE)
  3. MUTAMARID LSK (IRE)

races.name: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Apprentice Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
Two-time course winner DOCTOR GRACE is taken to capitalise on a return to calmer waters. Expound could be a serious threat, especially if the market speaks in his favour. In The Minus and Storm Eric also merit consideration.

  1. DOCTOR GRACE (IRE)
  2. EXPOUND
  3. IN THE MINUS (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Proud Supporter Of Irish Racing' Maiden
races.verdict:
In a maiden where few arrive with compelling claims last month's Gowran runner-up SANGREAL is taken to go one better at the expense of fellow 3-y-o filly Kashala, who is open to further progress after only 2 starts. Theorist may prove best of the remainder if a return to polytrack sees him recapture the form he showed here at this time last year.

  1. SANGREAL (IRE)
  2. KASHALA (IRE)
  3. THEORIST (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Best Odds Guaranteed Overnight' Handicap
races.verdict:
ANVIKA failed to finish through no fault of her own at the Curragh last month, having clipped heels and unseated her rider, so she's well worth another chance to supplement her recent Curragh success given she remains well treated on old form. Serenity Blue ought to go well again, while his stablemate Star Harbour is also of interest returning to all-weather.

  1. ANVIKA (IRE)
  2. SERENITY BLUE
  3. STAR HARBOUR (IRE)

races.name: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap
races.verdict:
GLITTER AND GLORY ran well to finish a close third here last time, and the step up in trip can see her resume winning ways. Love Orchid, African Affair and Chloe's Boy head the dangers in a competitive affair.

  1. GLITTER AND GLORY (IRE)
  2. LOVE ORCHID (IRE)
  3. AFRICAN AFFAIR (IRE)
